title: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection
title_zh: WeVisForensics：面向全模态 AI 生成视频检测的自演化智能体
abstract_en: Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. However, current methods primarily depend on single-pass chain-of-thought reasoning that overlooks brief or localized artifacts, or on predefined multi-agent workflows that offer limited flexibility in selecting relevant inspections. Even with adaptive investigation, optimizing the investigation policy alone does not directly improve the forensic capabilities of fixed experts. We introduce WeVisForensics, an agentic framework in which a main investigator agent coordinates a self-evolving library of forensic inspector sub-agents spanning visual and audio cues. The investigator learns which artifact type to examine, over which window, and when to conclude, and these interactions provide shared feedback for both levels of agents. Our dual-timescale policy optimization strategy, DTPO, closes this loop through fast reinforcement learning of the investigator and slower refinement of the inspectors, guided by annotated artifact intervals, to report subtle artifacts they once dismissed. Furthermore, we curate ForenCue-30K, combining role-specific forensic annotations and interaction trajectories to supervise individual inspections and their coordination, with an accompanying reinforcement-learning pool. Experiments show that WeVisForensics averages 95.2% detection accuracy across in-domain, out-of-domain and agentic benchmarks, 9.0% above the strongest prior detector, while grounding its verdicts in localized evidence.
abstract_zh: 可靠的 AI 生成视频检测不仅要判断真伪，还要给出明确的取证证据。现有的单轮思维链推理容易遗漏短暂或局部的异常，预设的多智能体流程则难以灵活选择检查项目。即便调查策略可以动态调整，仅优化调查者也无法直接提升固定取证专家的能力。WeVisForensics 由主调查智能体协调一组可自演化的视听取证子智能体，学习检查哪类异常、检查哪个时间窗口，以及何时结束调查。双时间尺度策略优化（DTPO）利用智能体交互产生的共享反馈，通过强化学习快速更新调查策略，并依据标注的异常时间区间逐步改进取证子智能体，使其能报告此前漏检的细微异常。作者还构建了 ForenCue-30K，提供按角色划分的取证标注、智能体交互轨迹和配套的强化学习样本池。实验中，该方法在域内、域外和智能体评测基准上的平均检测准确率为 95.2%，比最强的既有检测器高 9.0 个百分点，并能用定位到具体时间区间的证据支撑判断。
key_points_zh: 主调查智能体动态选择异常类型和检查时窗，并决定何时结束调查，避免依赖固定工作流。
DTPO 在两个时间尺度上优化策略：快速更新主调查智能体，缓慢改进视听取证子智能体。
ForenCue-30K 用角色专属标注监督单项取证，用交互轨迹监督智能体协作，并提供强化学习样本池。
跨三类评测基准的平均检测准确率为 95.2%，较最强既有检测器高 9.0 个百分点，且可给出定位到具体时段的证据。
